traits.label: Cautious about engagement
traits.text: He instructed General Ewell to avoid a general engagement until the arrival of other divisions of the army.

citation.doc: Lee's report on the Gettysburg campaign, January 1864 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 2, scan)
citation.quote: avoid a general engagement until the arrival of the other divisions of the army

traits.label: Accepts unavoidable battle
traits.text: He concluded that a battle had become in a measure unavoidable because the country was unfavorable for collecting supplies in the presence of the enemy.

citation.doc: Lee's report on the Gettysburg campaign, January 1864 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 2, scan)
citation.quote: A battle had, therefore, become in a measure unavoidable

traits.label: Continues attack after success
traits.text: He determined to continue the attack based on the belief that with proper concert of action and increased support, they would ultimately succeed.

citation.doc: Lee's report on the Gettysburg campaign, January 1864 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 2, scan)
citation.quote: it was accordingly determined to continue the attack
